assumptions: end_date is treated as effective relationship termination, per source README; this is not independently verified.
A logo is active when any linked subscription row is active; 1:N rows are collapsed to distinct account_id.
Invalid non-positive subscription intervals are excluded from interval continuity; they remain counted in source QA.
This is not a verified finance or customer-success churn KPI because event and flag definitions materially disagree.
2023.date_rule: start_date <= snapshot_date and (end_date is null or end_date > snapshot_date)
2023.interval_semantics: [start_date, end_date); blank end_date treated as open-ended per source README

movement_equation.note: Flow identity includes distinct first-observed additions active at close, prior-history returns active at close, date-boundary starts, and opening accounts inactive at close. It does not count within-period transient flows.
